mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within the last month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS increased by more than 0.5% in the last month.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.3 percentage points in the last month signals a weakening labor market, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where UNRATE increased by more than 0.3pp in the last month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP (GDPC1) over the last two quarters signals a weakening demand environment, which reduces corporate earnings and investor confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where GDPC1 declined over the last two quarters.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in the last month signals a strengthening supply side, which boosts corporate earnings and investor confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where INDPRO increased by more than 1% in the last month.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and a decrease in real personal savings (RSAFS) signals a shift in consumer spending from savings to real estate, which boosts related sectors and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where HOUST increased and RSAFS decreased simultaneously.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 100,000 in the last month signals a weakening labor market, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS decreased by more than 100,000 in the last month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) over the last three months signals inflationary pressure, which erodes real earnings and investor confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL increased over the last three months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in real GDP (GDPC1) and a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strengthening demand environment, which boosts corporate earnings and investor confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where GDPC1 increased and UNRATE decreased simultaneously.
